description: This file contains React hooks, types, and classes related to managing system properties and asynchronous operations within the Mattermost admin console, including error handling, state management, and data fetching.

classes.name: BatchProcessingError
classes.description: Custom error class for batch processing errors, with optional cause details.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Determines loading and error states from a generic loading state.

methods.name: useOperationStatus
methods.description: Custom hook to track loading and error status of an async operation.

methods.name: useOperation
methods.description: Custom hook to perform monitored async operations with error and loading state management.

methods.name: useThing
methods.description: Hook to retrieve and manage a current item from Redux store or async fetch.

methods.name: usePendingThing
methods.description: Hook to manage a pending version of an item for future saving, with patching and commit capabilities.
